firstRun.title: Welcome to Clash Mini
firstRun.intro: Looks like this is your first launch and no subscription has been added yet. Paste your subscription link below — node parsing, speed testing and network takeover are handled automatically.
firstRun.errEmpty: Please enter or paste a subscription link
firstRun.errScheme: The link must start with http:// or https://
firstRun.errImport: Import failed. Check the link and try again
firstRun.readyOk: Proxy is ready, network is up
firstRun.readyUnconfirmed: No node latency measured yet — testing may still be running, or the node is unavailable
firstRun.sysProxyOff: System proxy is off. Enable it in Settings and try again
firstRun.wikiHint: Open the Wiki to verify connectivity and learn more.
